remarks: Welcome to this highly desirable Beacon Park condo complex! This meticulously maintained end-unit home offers two bedrooms and two full baths, with an abundance of natural light throughout. The updated kitchen features Hickory cabinetry, a pantry, ceramic flooring, and a full appliance package including a stove, refrigerator, dishwasher, disposal, and microwave. The formal dining room opens to a spacious living room complete with a gas fireplace with Heatilator and sliding doors leading to the private balcony. The primary bedroom boasts a vaulted ceiling, large walk-in closet, and full en-suite bath featuring an oversized shower, ceramic flooring, wall-mounted television, and quartz countertop. The spacious second bedroom offers a lovely arched window, while the guest bath features ceramic flooring and a shower. The spacious basement provides endless possibilities along with excellent storage space. Additional features include central air, beautiful natural woodwork, a private entrance, and pet-friendly accommodations. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, and the thruway.  This comfortable condo is truly move-in and offers an open floor plan with plenty of space. Updates: Sliding door '26. Microwave '25. Primary bath '22. Furnace, central air '16.
